newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay buys Oriente, Santa Cruz crude for Dec.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay buys Oriente, Santa Cruz crude for Dec.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP bought a cargo each of Oriente and Santa Cruz crude for December delivery, trade sources said Friday.
Glencore sold 380,000 barrels of Oriente to ANCAP for January West Texas Intermediate minus $2.01 a barrel on a cost-and-freight basis, the sources said.
Interpetrol sold 250,000 barrels of Santa Cruz for January WTI minus 45 cents on the same basis.
The cargoes are to be delivered Dec 7-15.

Uruguay normally buys one million barrels of spot crude every four to six weeks, but a planned shutdown of the 34,600 barrel per day (bpd) La Teja refinery from Jan 21 to Feb 21 has trimmed short-term requirements.
The refiner is seeking to buy fuel oil, gas oil, and gasoline for delivery in February and March to cover its needs during the scheduled outage, the official said.
ANCAP plans to replace the refinery's catalytic cracker.
Elsewhere, Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) is seeking to buy 960,000 barrels of crude for delivery Jan 14-17, trade sources said. Offers are due December 4.
